description: Source code implementing diff core break logic for handling file modifications, including functions for deciding when to break file pairs based on edit size and merging broken pairs back together.

methods.name: should_break
methods.description: Determines whether a file pair should be broken based on edit size and other criteria.

methods.name: diffcore_break
methods.description: Breaks file pairs in the diff queue based on a break score, splitting large modifications into delete and create pairs.

methods.name: merge_broken
methods.description: Merges two broken file pairs back into a single pair.

methods.name: diffcore_merge_broken
methods.description: Merges broken pairs in the diff queue where possible.
